replacements.check: VALIDATE before effects or VERIFY after effects
replacements.problem / issue: exact error.*, event.*, FAILURE, MISSING, or UNKNOWN
replacements.try / attempt: ACTION; bounded RETRY for additional attempts
replacements.maybe / perhaps / possibly / probably: PREFER, conditional ASSUME, or typed probability data
replacements.soon / later / recently / latest: exact VERSION, DATE, DATETIME, ID, SOURCE, or CHECKSUM
replacements.as before / same as last time: explicit REF, IMPORT, CONTEXT, MEMORY, or STATE
replacements.carefully / properly / safely: specific REQUIRE, FORBID, PRESERVE, VALIDATE, and VERIFY clauses
